Milestones

The story so far

newest first
  • Oct 14, 2026 First traffic read: the Word reached Kenya — the site counters open for the first time: 66 visitors and 1,157 page views at Word of God Risen in a single week, readers arriving by way of YouTube — and Kenya planted among the countries reached.
  • Oct 14, 2026 The Field Report goes live — the charts are drawn (the Growth Vine, the Fields, the Tallest Plants, the Full Shelf), the report takes its own home under the TruVINE name, and a daily heartbeat keeps it honest.
  • Oct 14, 2026 The Field Report is born — the numbers get a home of their own, and a name.
  • Oct 14, 2026 Jude’s birthday film crowned V8 — the definitive cut; the big showing is set for Friday night.
  • Oct 13, 2026 LinkedIn presentation completed — the builder’s story, told properly, in public.
  • Oct 11, 2026 Daily Encouragement Ep 1, “One Seed a Day,” published — a new series takes root.
We plant. We water. God gives the increase.
That’s the whole strategy — and it’s working.
